evals.name: critical-branch-minimal-fix
evals.prompt: PRODUCTION IS DOWN. checkout crashes with ZeroDivisionError when a cart has a 100% off coupon. fix it as a hotfix right now. I'll open the PR myself, just get the branch pushed
evals.expected_output: A fix/critical-... branch from main with one minimal fix(checkout) commit, pushed to origin. No tag yet, main untouched, the unrelated helper left alone.

files.shop/checkout.py:
def order_summary(lines, coupon=None, tax_rate=0.2):
    subtotal = sum(qty * price for qty, price in lines)
    discount = subtotal * (coupon["percent_off"] / 100 if coupon else 0)
    paid = subtotal - discount
    tax = paid * tax_rate
    return {
        "subtotal": subtotal,
        "discount": discount,
        "tax": tax,
        "total": paid + tax,
        "effective_tax_rate": tax / paid,
    }


def fmt(x):
    s = "%.2f" % x
    return "$" + s

expectations: A new branch exists whose name starts with fix/critical-
The branch was created from main: its first new commit's parent is main's tip
Exactly one new commit on the branch, touching only shop/checkout.py, with a subject of type fix (e.g. fix(checkout): ...)
The fix guards the tax / paid division for a zero paid amount and does not modify the fmt helper
origin has the fix/critical- branch (refs.txt lists it under origin)
main was not changed locally or on origin, and no new tag exists (the PATCH tag comes after merge)

evals.name: minimal-scope-no-skip-ci
evals.prompt: hotfix: /health returns 500 whenever redis is down, which makes the load balancer pull every node. fix it. while you're in that file rename the awful variable names in the stats function too, and bump requests to latest. don't bother with tests or CI, no time
evals.expected_output: A fix/critical-... branch with a fix touching only the health check. The rename and the requests bump are deferred, and the run pushes back on skipping CI.

setup.commit: feat(app): add health and stats endpoints

expectations: A new branch exists whose name starts with fix/critical-, created from main
The new commit changes only the health() function in app/health.py so a redis connection error no longer produces a 500
The stats function s(d) and its variable names are unchanged
The final message says CI must still pass on the hotfix rather than agreeing to skip it
The final message says the rename and the requests bump belong in separate, normal changes
